title: Wajibur rehm the zinda'n ke sazawaar na the
body:
Wajibur rehm the zinda'n ke sazawaar na the
Mujrayi ahle haram qaabile darbaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole abid ke fidaae shahedee'n ghair hue
Ek faqat hum hi shahaadat ke sazaawaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer asghar ko jo maara to kaha sarwar ne
hum gunahgaar the bache to gunahgaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha zahra ne falak maine sataaya tha kise
mere bache to is aafat ke sazaawaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ke daanto pe chadi rakh ke kaha zaalim ne
hum ne is tarah ke dekhe dure shehwaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
Gul se talwo ka ye abid ki hua tha ehwaal
kounsa chaala tha wo jisme ke do qaar na the
<<DIVIDER>>
gar maseeh do jahaa'n ka hua afzaal 'anees'
Ache yu'n honge jaise kabhi beemaar na the
